name: @clarity/shared-models
description: Single source of truth for domain models shared between the Socket.IO backend (socket-server, via the @models/* tsconfig path -> ../shared_models/models/*) and the Angular frontend (frontend, via relative imports to ../shared_models/models/*). Consumed directly as TypeScript source; intentionally NOT built or published, so both apps always compile the same files. The shared_models/dist folder is stale legacy output and is not consumed by either app.
